articles.summary: This article explores how artificial intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing construction detailing in architecture and engineering. Historically, detailing relied on craftsmanship, but with the advent of computational tools, AI has become a game-changer. From generative design to material optimization, AI tools assist in creating intricate details efficiently. Despite challenges, integrating AI with technologies like virtual reality promises further innovation. Ultimately, AI streamlines the design process, offering new possibilities for achieving aesthetic and functional balance in construction details.
